raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Render explicit placeholder text for synthetic speculative acceptance in offline generation and OpenAI Chat Completions/Completions. Addresses https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/59750 (Option 2).

## Claims

- Return `"synthetic "` once per delivered output token ID while retaining real token IDs, detokenization, and stop checks.
- Bypass chat output parsers for synthetic responses and mark successful HTTP responses with `x-vllm-synthetic-output: true`.
- Reject structured output, required/named tool calls, generated-output API logprobs, prompt echo, and beam search where placeholder text would violate the request contract.
- Reject transcription, translation, and realtime speech-to-text before generation because these adapters consume generated text as semantic output.

## Validation

- Ruff 0.14.0 `check` and `format --check` on changed Python files: passed.
- `git diff --check`: passed.
- Locally ran repository hook scripts for test-to-Buildkite tethering, SPDX headers, root lazy imports, forbidden imports, `torch.cuda` calls, and boolean context managers on the changed files: passed.
- CPU focused output-processor tests: 10 passed, 60 deselected. Command: `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 /test-venv/bin/python -m pytest --noconftest -p no:cacheprovider tests/v1/engine/test_output_processor.py -k "synthetic_output_preserves_token_ids or delta_output_without_new_tokens or remote_prefill_cached_tokens_override" -q`.
- CPU focused Chat API tests: 5 passed, 191 deselected. Command: `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 /test-venv/bin/python -m pytest --noconftest -p pytest_asyncio.plugin -p no:cacheprovider tests/entrypoints/openai/chat_completion/test_serving_chat.py -k "synthetic_stream_skips_output_parser or synthetic_chat_rejects_incompatible_requests" -q`.
- Review-follow-up CPU regression tests for synthetic-mode beam search and speech-to-text rejection: the human submitter personally ran `docker exec codex-vllm-cpu-dtest sh -c 'cd /tmp/vllm-local && PYTHONPATH=/tmp/vllm-local PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 /test-venv/bin/python -m pytest --noconftest -p pytest_asyncio.plugin -p no:cacheprovider tests/entrypoints/speech_to_text/test_synthetic_output.py tests/entrypoints/openai/chat_completion/test_serving_chat.py tests/entrypoints/openai/completion/test_completion_error.py -k synthetic -q'`; 12 passed, 232 deselected, 14 PyTorch deprecation warnings. This covers both OpenAI generation endpoints, transcription/translation, and realtime transcription.
- Follow-up code-audit CPU regressions on `d641584`: the human submitter personally ran the explicit pytest node IDs for generative-scoring validation/generation and offline beam-search rejection/abort behavior; **14 passed**, with 14 PyTorch deprecation warnings. This covers the new synthetic-mode guards and confirms normal scoring remains functional.
- After syncing latest `main` in `057de10`, the AI assistant reran the focused generative-scoring and offline beam-search tests against the merged checkout: **17 passed**, with 14 PyTorch deprecation warnings. The updated upstream test classes include three more selected cases than the submitter's pre-merge 14-test run.
- On the October 23 merged checkout, the human submitter ran the two synthetic Chat Completions pytest node IDs: **6 passed**, with 14 PyTorch deprecation warnings (this preceded the final upstream chat-stream refactor merge).
- Against the final chat-stream refactor merge, the AI assistant ran the same two node IDs plus three upstream streaming regression nodes in `tests/entrypoints/openai/chat_completion/test_serving_chat.py`: **17 passed**, with 14 PyTorch deprecation warnings. Command: `docker exec -w /work/vllm -e PYTHONPATH=/work/.cpu-test-deps:/work/vllm -e PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 -e PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 codex-vllm-cpu-dtest /test-venv/bin/python -m pytest --noconftest -p pytest_asyncio.plugin -p no:cacheprovider tests/entrypoints/openai/chat_completion/test_serving_chat.py::test_synthetic_stream_skips_output_parser tests/entrypoints/openai/chat_completion/test_serving_chat.py::test_synthetic_chat_rejects_incompatible_requests tests/entrypoints/openai/chat_completion/test_serving_chat.py::test_streaming_chunks_keep_usage_and_metadata tests/entrypoints/openai/chat_completion/test_serving_chat.py::test_streaming_serialization_failure_emits_error_and_done tests/entrypoints/openai/chat_completion/test_serving_chat.py::test_streaming_errors_preserve_envelope -q`. The isolated CPU test environment needed `orjson==3.12.0`, supplied by `uv pip install --target` for Linux without changing the repository.
- The existing real-model speculative acceptance test now asserts one `"synthetic "` placeholder per generated token ID, and its nightly Buildkite job is tethered to `vllm/v1/engine/output_processor.py`. The AI assistant validated the same contract through CPU `LLM.generate` with `HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct`, ngram speculation, and two prompts: **4 IDs and 4 placeholders per prompt**. The GPU nightly test itself could not be run locally.
- End-to-end CPU serving validation with `HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct`, ngram speculative decoding, two draft tokens, synthetic rejection sampling, and a target acceptance length of two: passed. The human submitter personally reran `docker exec codex-vllm-cpu-dtest sh -c 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 /test-venv/bin/python /work/validate_vllm_cpu_59750.py'`; it returned 4/4 successful generation requests (streaming and nonstreaming Chat Completions and Completions), each with four completion tokens, exactly four `"synthetic "` placeholders, and `x-vllm-synthetic-output: true`. Prompt echo and structured output were rejected with HTTP 400 as expected. This is output-contract validation, not an accuracy or throughput benchmark. No GPU validation was available.

## Details

Synthetic acceptance can generate IDs that decode or parse to no visible content, causing benchmark clients to reject an otherwise completed request. The replacement occurs after the existing delta/cumulative ID selection in `RequestState._new_completion_output()`. Real decoding and stop detection remain active. Beam search reconstructs text after that substitution, so synthetic-mode beam requests are rejected at both OpenAI generation endpoints and in offline `LLM.beam_search()`. Generative scoring rejects synthetic mode before generation while allowing existing mock-based normal-mode tests without a `vllm_config` attribute. Speech-to-text adapters require semantic generated text and are rejected before engine generation, including realtime transcription. The placeholder is benchmark text, not model content; use server-reported token counts rather than retokenizing it.

This differs from open PR https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/59650, which selects synthetic acceptance length per request but does not define an output-presentation policy. An open-PR search for `59750 in:body` found no match.

The placeholder changes response size and visible-content timing. Clients that append it to later prompts change prompt lengths and cache behavior. No speedup or output-quality claim is made. The GitHub pre-commit workflow is blocked at its label-based `pre-run-check` for this first-time contributor; the actual pre-commit job has not run. The local checks above passed. Full CI and GPU performance measurements remain unverified.

AI assistance was used to research, implement, and validate this change. The human submitter confirmed line-by-line review of every changed line, personally ran the successful end-to-end serving script, and personally ran the 12 review-follow-up regression tests and the 14 code-audit CPU regressions.

---

- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.

</details>
